summary: Reduce food loss and strengthen temperature controls with practical HACCP, FEFO and traceability exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Food cold-chain resilience focuses on maintaining suitable conditions and responding when storage or distribution is disrupted. It is for food safety officers, cold-store supervisors, quality managers and logistics planners who need to reduce avoidable losses through practical controls. Participants practise mapping product flows and risks, reviewing temperature-time records, calculating loss baselines, applying FEFO stock decisions, documenting corrective actions and planning recovery responses.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle food safety, temperature control, inventory decisions or loss reporting across chilled and frozen food operations.
modules: Food Loss Measurement and Mass Balance
Cold-Chain KPI Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Prior experience in food handling, food storage, food quality, food safety or food distribution is expected. Familiarity with basic HACCP concepts is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
